name: What is involved in a freestanding tub installation?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a freestanding tub installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A freestanding tub installation is a comprehensive process that goes beyond simply placing the tub. It typically involves assessing the bathroom's structural capacity, precisely locating and extending plumbing lines for water supply and drainage, and ensuring the subfloor can support the tub's weight when filled. AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process coordinates these elements, including potential floor reinforcement, new fixture connections, and final finish work around the tub, creating a spa-inspired feature within your luxury bathroom renovation. Our team manages this from initial design to the final walkthrough, ensuring seamless integration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding tub installation involves structural assessment, precise plumbing work, and floor reinforcement to support the tub and ensure proper drainage and water supply.
